title: Which Classes of Storage Charge Are Drawn Into a Settlement
content:
Which classes of charge are drawn into the settlement follows how the programme recovers its money. This rule governs settlements on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements, and it reads the programme's recovery basis and how many classes of charge stand unpaid on the account.

## What the tariff lays down

Where the programme does not settle storage out of grain proceeds and charges of more than one class stand unpaid, every storage charge standing unpaid on the account is drawn in, because the member has no settlement statement for any of them to be taken out of.

Where the programme settles storage out of grain proceeds, only the storage accruals standing unpaid are drawn in, the conditioning and handling charges being taken out of the settlement statement the bushels are paid on.

And otherwise the storage accruals and the handling charges standing unpaid are drawn in.

## The three classes counted

A class counts as standing unpaid where money of that class stands unpaid on the account. The three classes are the storage accruals, the handling charges and the conditioning charges. Where two or three of them carry unpaid money, charges of more than one class stand unpaid.

## The programme's recovery basis

| Programme | Storage settled out of grain proceeds |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | yes |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no |

## Judgement table

| Programme settles out of grain proceeds | Classes standing unpaid | Drawn into the settlement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no | more than one | every storage charge standing unpaid on the account |
| no | one or none | the storage accruals and the handling charges standing unpaid |
| yes | any number | only the storage accruals standing unpaid |

## Worked selections, on hypothetical accounts

**A programme that does not settle out of grain proceeds, with accruals of 300.00, handling of 75.00 and conditioning of 210.00 standing unpaid.** Three classes stand unpaid, so every unpaid charge is drawn in: 585.00.

**A programme that settles out of grain proceeds, with the same three amounts standing unpaid.** Only the accruals are drawn in: 300.00.

**A programme that does not settle out of grain proceeds, with accruals of 300.00 standing unpaid and nothing else.** One class stands unpaid, so the accruals and the handling charges standing unpaid are drawn in, which here is 300.00 and nothing more.
